summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing the results of its 24th Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders. The meeting approved a fiscal-year-end dividend of ¥79 per share, a 2-for-1 stock split effective October 1, 2026, and the election of thirteen directors, including one new director. A shareholder proposal to amend articles regarding share repurchase authority was disapproved. This is a routine annual meeting notice with standard agenda items; no special situation event or transaction is involved.
